paragraphs.text: 深度求索时，派一只像素蓝鲸为你喷水摆尾。
# PixelWhale 🐋
深度求索时，派一只像素蓝鲸为你喷水摆尾。

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web UI plugin: while the model is thinking, the native
「深度求索中…」/ "Deep divi

ng…" status row becomes a **pixel-art DeepSeek blue whale**
spouting and wagging its tail, next to t

he same status text rendered in a **pixel
font** with a glyph-level shimmer.
## Features

- 🐋 **Animated pixel whale** — the hand-drawn DeepSeek blue-whale art (40×25 grid,
6-tone palette),

expanded into an 84-frame spout + tail-wag loop, downsampled to
27×18 and painted as a CSS sprite sh

eet (`steps()` animation).
- 🔤 **Real pixel font** — Fusion Pixel 12px,
subsetted to exactly the cha

racters the status row uses (ASCII + the Chinese
glyphs + a narrowed middle dot), embedded as WOFF2

so it works offline.
- ✨ **Glyph-level shimmer** — the moving highlight is clipped to the text glyph

s
(`background-clip: text`), so it travels across the strokes instead of the row.
- 📐 **Sits on the

text baseline** — `align-items: baseline` on the status row puts
the bottom of the whale on the same

line as the bottom of the glyphs, hugging the
text on its left.
- 🎯 **Non-invasive** — the native t

ext node, language, timer and update logic are
untouched; only CSS is applied to the thinking row.
-

🪶 **Zero runtime overhead** — no `MutationObserver`, no polling, no timers, no
DOM writes after set

up. The client half injects a single `<style>` element and
nothing else runs, so there is no per-fra

me work and no memory growth while
streaming.
## Install
From the DSH plugin market, or:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then restart DSH.
## How it works

- The host half (`lib/index.js`) is a client-only cosmetics entry — it just mounts
the bundle and ex

poses the browser half via `exports["./client"]`.
- The client half (`lib/client.js`) injects one `<

style>` element containing:
- `@font-face` rules for the subsetted pixel font, scoped with `unicode-

ning="true"] [class*="runningIcon"]`), which replaces the
shipped whale drawing without inserting an

-motion: reduce` fallback that pins the first frame and drops
the shimmer.

Everything is keyed on the `[data-chat-running="true"]` attribute DSH puts on the
thinking row, so t
he whole effect appears and disappears with that row.

Verified against DSH 2.0.20-next. Selectors are attribute/substring based
(`data-chat-running`, `run

ningIcon`, `runningContent`, `runningText`) rather than
hashed CSS-module names, so they tolerate or
dinary client rebuilds.
## Font license

The embedded pixel font is Fusion Pixel Font,
licensed under **SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-1.1)**

. See `FONT-LICENSE-OFL.txt`.
Font copyright belongs to TakWolf (https://takwolf.com) and upstream f

LICENSE-OFL.txt`.
Font copyright belongs to TakWolf (https://takwolf.com) and upstream font authors.

The whale frames are derived from the DeepSeek blue-whale art used by
dsh-TUI / dsh-ui-whale, courte

es are derived from the DeepSeek blue-whale art used by
dsh-TUI / dsh-ui-whale, courtesy of @lhh010.
## License
MIT (see `package.json`). The bundled font carries its own OFL-1.1 license.
